title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Anime, My Melody & Kuromi Stop-Motion Animated Series Nominated for International Emmy
content: Winners will be announced at New York City on November 23. The Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 had its world premiere in October 2025 during the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival 2025 at the TCL Chinese 6 Theatre in Hollywood.
author: ANN

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 Anime Returns for 3rd Part in July 2027, Clayman's Revenge Spinoff Anime Debuts in April
content: The staff for the fourth That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ( Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken ) anime season revealed on Friday that the anime will return for its third cours (quarter of a year) in July 2027.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Drops Final Trailer Ahead of October Debut – Watch
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is right around the corner, and it’s going to be the biggest quarter of the year. The season has several exciting sequels planned for fans. As expected, The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is at the center of attention after the explosive popularity of the franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: Monochrome, Good Smile Unveil Ignisphere Mixed Media Project, Along With Project's Dawngazer Action RPG
content: Monochrome Corp. and Good Smile Company announced a new mixed media IP titled Ignisphere on Friday, along with the first title announced for the franchise , an action RPG titled Dawngazer .
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 New Trailer Previews Ending Song by Eve
content: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 revealed a new trailer and ending theme song by Eve ahead of its October 2, 2026 premiere. The anime will lead up to the upcoming movie , which will premiere in Japan on December 11 with an original story by the author Natsu Hyuuga.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Anime's 2nd Trailer Reveals Eve's Ending Theme
content: TOHO animation began streaming a new trailer for the third season of the anime based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season Part 2' Announces Additional Cast, Character Promo
content: The official website of the Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ( Mission: Yozakura Family ) television anime announced additional cast members for its second part of second season on Friday. The second part is scheduled to premiere on October 11 at 5.00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

content: The staff for the Duel Masters LOST anime series revealed the main promotional video on Friday for the anime's fourth part , Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy). The above video reveals and previews Tsukuyomi 's ending theme song "Tuitachi feat.

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2's Video Reveals 5 Cast Members
content: The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga revealed a new promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video reveals five new cast members for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Chizuna Nakajima's Where is the Elf Teacher's Toilet? Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Kadokawa announced on Friday that Chizuna Nakajima 's Elf-Sensei no Toire wa Doko Desu ka? ( Where is the Elf Teacher's Toilet? ) manga is getting a television anime adaptation.
author: ANN
